title: Gloria (Johannes Okeghem, Missa De plus en plus)
desc: Johannes Okeghem, Missa De plus en plus, Gloria. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
